remarks: Move right in to this newly constructed and renovated 6 bedroom, 4 full,2 1/2 bath home in the heart of Riverside! You will be wowed by the incredible craftsmanship of this well thought out 3483 Sq. Ft. addition that includes a stunning new kitchen with a 5x9 peninsula and beautiful cabinetry. Fun family room with a FP. Sparkling new wood floors. Open layout is ideal for family/ friends gathering. Brand new luxurious Primary BR and Bath. Walk in Closet. Additional BR, ensuite. Two lower level areas provide endless opportunity! Bedroom w/ full bath (au pair suite), office, family room, gym.....Great space to configure for any lifestyle needs.Two car garage and storage galore. Expansive yard with brand new landscaping and Terrace. Great location close to train. Walk to Elementary and Middle School. https://tour.realtyplans.com/sites/pnzjngv/unbranded
